trap.label: would rather + base
trap.wrong: I would rather to stay home.
trap.why: O português "preferiria ficar" leva infinitivo; em inglês would rather é seguido de base sem to.

opts: She prefers to cycling to driving.
Do you would rather eat out?
Would you rather to eat out?
I'd rather that you stay to.

fix.wrong: Would you rather going by train?
fix.right: Would you rather go by train?

fix.wrong: We prefer walk than take the bus.
fix.right: We prefer walking to taking the bus.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a negativa: “I'd rather go.”
Reescreva com prefer -ing: “She likes reading better than watching TV.”
rewrite.answer: She prefers reading to watching TV.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para pergunta: “You would rather eat now.”
